text:
evan_csr: Customer (MediCore) raised a P0: high gen latency, intermittent 500s, SCIM deprovision fails, and audit export missing ~40m. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/MDCORE-4092
lee_ops: which deployment? hosted/dedicated? any KMS integration?
evan_csr: Dedicated in us-west-2, customer-managed KMS (HSM proxy). snippets from runtime:
```
2025-06-03T11:12:33Z runtime ERROR req=abcd123 kms unwrap timeout
2025-06-03T11:12:35Z hsm-proxy WARN conn_retries=4 queue=82
2025-06-03T11:13:00Z audit-export ERROR failed upload: 500 S3
```
alex.chen: can you paste a curl repro (redact keys)? and SCIM webhook log lines?
evan_csr: repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"medicore","model":"redwood-2-large","input":"test"}'
```
logs from SCIM worker:
```
2025-06-03T11:12:45Z scim-worker ERROR deprov 500 tenant=medicore reason="kms-decrypt-timeout"
2025-06-03T11:12:50Z scim-worker WARN retry scheduled backoff=5s
```
tara_security: missing audit rows = compliance issue. mark P1 and preserve evidence. @ops-bot lock exports and snapshot indexes
ops-bot: evidence collection started: snapshotting /var/log/redwood/, locking s3://redwood-evidence/IR-2025-0603, capturing KMS request traces. DO NOT rotate tenant keys.
sam_li: billing shows a surge from 11:12 -> 11:30, ~5x baseline tokens for tenant medicore. likely caused by retries. will draft provisional credit, need to know origin of retries (client vs server)
lee_ops: quick grep I ran:
```
rg "kms unwrap|deprov 500|audit-export" /var/log/redwood/*.log | head -n 200
```
sample:
```
/var/log/redwood/hsm-proxy.log:2025-06-03T11:12:34Z WARN conn_failures=3 queue_depth=90
/var/log/redwood/runtime.log:2025-06-03T11:12:33Z ERROR kms unwrap timeout req=abcd123
/var/log/redwood/audit-export.log:2025-06-03T11:13:01Z ERROR PutObject failed 500
```
lee_ops: hypothesis: transient HSM connectivity -> unwrap timeouts -> runtime retries -> SCIM worker retries -> audit-export backlog and failed uploads -> missing export window + billing spike
maria.gomez: immediate mitigations: 1) enable tenant fallback (service key) 2) pause SCIM deprov worker for tenant 3) increase hsm-proxy pool and adjust retry backoff
alex.chen: staging repro (do NOT run against prod):
```
# simulate HSM flakiness in staging
for i in {1..80}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","input":"x"}' & done
```
alex.chen: logs to gather: runtime.log, hsm-proxy.log, audit-export.log, scim-worker.log, metrics/token-counts. collect KMS request ids.
lee_ops: mitigation actions I will perform now:
- enable tenant fallback key via admin API
- throttle SCIM retries: set exponential backoff and pause immediate deprov
- bump hsm-proxy max_conns 60 -> 120 temporarily
- replay audit-export backlog after uploads succeed and tag export as incomplete window
runbook steps:
```
1) POST /v1/admin/tenants/medicore/config {"fallback_key": true}
2) systemctl restart hsm-proxy && watch queue_depth
3) POST /internal/scim/pause?tenant=medicore
4) /opt/redwood/bin/snapshot_evidence.sh IR-2025-0603
```
tara_security: assign roles:
- alex.chen: upload logs to evidence bucket and index KMS traces
- lee_ops: enable fallback, monitor for 60m
- sam_li: prepare credit calc and customer-facing billing note
- maria.gomez: coordinate with customer IdP to prevent orphan accounts
- evan_csr: communicate mitigations and request any client logs
lee_ops: note — DO NOT rotate the tenant KMS key until security signs off
evan_csr: updated the ticket and emailed customer with mitigation steps. will follow up when audit export replay completes. :white_check_mark:
